paper_title: Search for hidden-photon cold dark matter using a K-band cryogenic receiver
notes: Dish-antenna-style haloscope search for hidden-photon CDM using a planar aluminum plate and K-band cryogenic receiver (27.998-28.012 GHz, i.e. 115.79-115.85 ueV). No signal found; 95% CL upper limit chi < 1.8-4.3e-10 across the band. Exact frequency-by-frequency limit values are only shown in Figure 7 (not tabulated), so the two data points encode the quoted range: the limit oscillates between ~1.8e-10 (best) and ~4.3e-10 (worst) over the narrow mass window; the assignment of the extreme values to the endpoints is schematic, not from the figure. Assumes standard halo model (Maxwell-Boltzmann, vc ~ 220 km/s) and local DM density 0.39 GeV/cm^3 (Catena & Ullio). | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.75, 2))
